name: Copper wire and cord
summary: Copper wire, cords and cable, from mains cords and house wiring to enamelled magnet wire.
uses: Wiring solar, battery and lighting systems
identify: Cords on every appliance, house wiring in walls (NM or Romex), extension cords, and speaker and network cable. Magnet wire is shiny copper with a thin varnish, inside motors, transformers and coils.
test: Check insulation for cracks and burns and test continuity end to end; thicker wire carries more current. Never cut building wiring that might still be live from solar or a generator.
